name: comparative_adjective
description: Form the comparative of an adjective (big -> bigger, good -> better). Control: same format but repeat the base adjective.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
A=[('big','bigger'),('small','smaller'),('long','longer'),('short','shorter'),('fast','faster'),('slow','slower'),('tall','taller'),('old','older'),('young','younger'),('strong','stronger'),('weak','weaker'),('hard','harder'),('soft','softer'),('good','better'),('bad','worse'),('large','larger'),('high','higher'),('low','lower'),('cold','colder'),('warm','warmer'),('deep','deeper'),('wide','wider'),('rich','richer'),('poor','poorer'),('clean','cleaner'),('dark','darker'),('bright','brighter'),('heavy','heavier'),('easy','easier'),('happy','happier')]
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    sh=random.sample(A,3); q=random.choice([a for a in A if a not in sh])
    p=''.join(f"Adjective: {a}\nComparative: {b}\n\n" for a,b in sh)+f"Adjective: {q[0]}\nComparative:"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+q[1]})
    p2=''.join(f"Adjective: {a}\nBase form: {a}\n\n" for a,b in sh)+f"Adjective: {q[0]}\nBase form:"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":" "+q[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
